description: Test suite for the iscc_sdk video metadata and processing functions, including embedding/extracting metadata, generating thumbnails, signatures, and granular scene analysis.

classes.name: IsccMeta
classes.description: Class representing metadata for ISCC videos, including fields like name, description, creator, license, etc.

methods.name: test_video_metadata_extract_mp4
methods.description: Tests extraction of metadata from an MP4 video file.

methods.name: test_video_metadata_embed_mp4
methods.description: Tests embedding metadata into an MP4 video and verifying extraction.

methods.name: test_video_metadata_extract_mov
methods.description: Tests extraction of metadata from a MOV video file.

methods.name: test_video_metadata_embed_mov
methods.description: Tests embedding metadata into a MOV video and verifying extraction.

methods.name: test_video_metadata_escaping
methods.description: Tests handling of special characters and escape sequences in metadata.

methods.name: test_video_thumbnail

methods.name: test_video_mp7sig_extract

methods.name: test_video_mp7sig_extract_scenes_compat

methods.name: test_video_mp7sig_extract_scenes_detected

methods.name: test_video_parse_scenes_empty

methods.name: test_video_features_extract_store
methods.description: Tests storing of extracted video features.

methods.name: test_code_video_granular_scenes
